verdict.rationale: Evidence shows time-off requests are integrated into Rippling's time-and-attendance app and that time off syncs automatically with payroll (docs-28, docs-18), implying some PTO-to-payroll automation, but there is no explicit documentation of configurable accrual rules or approval workflow chains for PTO policies. missing for 10: accrual rule configuration, PTO-specific approval workflow documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of accuracy.
